meta.название: Системные требования и источники для диссертации
meta.тема: Синтетическое мультимодальное предобучение на коннектомной модели Drosophila для проверки переноса на межсубъектную оценку болевого состояния и условного прогноза ответа на SCS
meta.исходная_тема: Биологически обоснованная генерация синтетических ECAP-сигналов на основе коннектома Drosophila для кросс-субъектной детекции боли при SCS
meta.статус_валидации: частично проверено; непроверенные ресурсы не являются доказательной базой

ресурсы.назначение: Основной источник коннектома взрослой мухи (v783: 139 255 нейронов, ~50M синапсов)
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: FAFB v783: мозг взрослой самки; 139255 нейронов. Для CNS/VNC использовать отдельные наборы.

ресурсы.назначение: Tutorials for programmatic FlyWire access through CAVE, meshes and Codex exports.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Repository content checked; simulation capability is not claimed.
проверенные_утверждения: Repository contains CAVE and mesh-access notebooks for FlyWire.
README identifies Codex as the bulk-download source.
ограничения_валидации: Data-access tutorials only; this is not a neural or embodied simulator.

ресурсы.назначение: Network-analysis scripts and derived products for the FlyWire v630 snapshot.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Retained as analysis prior art; version mismatch must be explicit.
проверенные_утверждения: Repository contains scripts for network analyses of the FlyWire connectome.
README links the associated network and data preprints.
ограничения_валидации: The published scripts describe the v630 snapshot, not current v783 data.

ресурсы.назначение: Research repository with preparation notebooks for FAFB, MaleCNS and related connectome data.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Specific v783 convenience-interface claim was removed as unconfirmed.
проверенные_утверждения: Repository exists and contains FAFB, maleCNS and other preparation workflows.
ограничения_валидации: The repository landing page does not confirm the imported claim about a tinyurl v783 interface.
Individual notebooks and their data-version assumptions still require execution-level review.

ресурсы.назначение: Веб-интерфейс для детального изучения коннектома
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Интерактивный просмотр FAFB; не функциональный симулятор.

ресурсы.назначение: Python-библиотека цифрового двойника мухи; симуляция сенсомоторного контроля, зрение, обоняние, ходьба
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Официальная документация embodied-модели; nociception/ECAP не реализованы автоматически.

ресурсы.назначение: FlyWire v783 LIF benchmark implementation across six simulation backends.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Suitable simulator candidate only after local reproducibility and biological-scope checks.
проверенные_утверждения: Repository provides Brian2, Brian2CUDA, PyTorch, NEST GPU, GeNN and Brian2GeNN backends.
README documents FlyWire v783 input files and reproducible benchmark commands.
ограничения_валидации: This is a connectome-constrained LIF benchmark, not an embodied nociception model.
Repository-reported benchmark results were not independently rerun in this audit.

ресурсы.назначение: Experimental repository claiming FlyWire-derived spiking activity coupled to a simulated body.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Do not cite as a validated whole-brain emulation or nociception model.
проверенные_утверждения: Repository and accompanying 2026 Zenodo preprint are linked from the README.
README describes a FlyWire-derived spiking network coupled to NeuroMechFly/MuJoCo.
ограничения_валидации: Scientific and behavioral claims are self-reported and not independently validated here.
The README clone command points to a differently named repository.
Claims of primacy and low-cost hardware are not evidence of biological fidelity.

ресурсы.назначение: Interactive browser LIF visualization derived from a reduced FlyWire v783 graph.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Candidate for software comparison, not direct biological ground truth.
проверенные_утверждения: README states 139,255 LIF neurons and 2.7M connections from FlyWire FAFB v783.
The implementation runs in a browser Web Worker and exposes interactive stimuli.
ограничения_валидации: Behavior-emergence statements are repository claims, not peer-reviewed validation.
The connection reduction from the source connectome requires methodological review.

ресурсы.назначение: LIF-модель всего мозга Drosophila; spike times и rates всех нейронов
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Открытая LIF-модель; требует отдельной проверки соответствия версии коннектома и воспроизводимости.

ресурсы.назначение: Experimental MaleCNS/FlyGym environment with explicit hybrid behavioral controllers.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Useful integration scaffold; engineered behavior must not be attributed to the connectome.
проверенные_утверждения: Repository combines MaleCNS data, a NeuroMechFly body and explicit controllers.
README documents local preparation, checksums and diagnostic/ablation controls.
ограничения_валидации: The authors explicitly describe it as experimental and not physiologically validated.
Several displayed behaviors are engineered controllers and can run with the connectome disabled.

ресурсы.назначение: Infrastructure benchmark for resident and streamed execution of a MaleCNS-derived sparse graph.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Retain for runtime engineering only, not as neuroscience validation.
проверенные_утверждения: Repository implements resident and streamed sparse-graph runtimes for MaleCNS data.
README labels measured, estimated and not-tested evidence separately.
ограничения_валидации: No biological calibration or scientific fidelity claim is made.
Reported timings are host-specific infrastructure measurements.

ресурсы.назначение: Two-stage SNN/RNN workflow for fitting region-level Drosophila neural dynamics.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Promising simulation candidate subject to local reproduction and task-specific validation.
проверенные_утверждения: Repository implements a two-stage SNN plus RNN activity-fitting workflow.
README identifies FlyWire 630/783 and Drosophila neural recordings as inputs.
README links the associated Nature Communications article DOI 10.1038/s41467-026-68453-w.
ограничения_валидации: The local workflow was not executed in this audit.
Activity fitting does not establish nociception, pain or embodied behavior validity.

ресурсы.назначение: Primary project page and preprint/code links for adult Drosophila nociceptive circuit reconstruction.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Use only for nociceptive pathways and defensive behavior, not subjective pain.
проверенные_утверждения: Author project page describes circuit reconstruction, optogenetics and behavior analysis for adult-fly nociception.
The page links preprint DOI 10.1101/2025.10.28.684868 and its analysis-code repository.
ограничения_валидации: The imported md-neuron to two-pathway summary was not verified from the project page alone.
The linked work is a preprint and must not be treated as settled evidence of subjective pain.

ресурсы.назначение: Восходящие пути: Ipsigoro → Goro; роль KCs в escape response (S029, S091)
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Препринт; DOI 10.1101/2025.10.28.684868. Не считать рецензированной журнальной статьей.

ресурсы.назначение: Official MaleCNS v1.0 download and programmatic-access page for the complete male CNS connectome.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Use explicit release, filtering and count definitions in every derived dataset.
проверенные_утверждения: Official project provides MaleCNS v1.0 annotations, connectivity, skeletons and neuPrint access.
Official project reports 166,700 neurons across brain and ventral nerve cord.
Dataset is licensed CC BY.
ограничения_валидации: MaleCNS and female FAFB/FlyWire are different specimens and scopes.
The original 25.5M-connections wording was removed because the official download exposes multiple count definitions.

ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Figshare v3; PMED 55 и PMCD 49 участников; DOI 10.1038/s41597-024-03878-w.

ресурсы.данные: sEMG + ECG + кинематика верхних конечностей; DOMS vs musculoskeletal disorders; 6h4m данных
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Version 1.0.1 and the exact Zenodo DOI were confirmed.
проверенные_утверждения: Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.17704417 provides ECG, sEMG, upper-limb inertial data and binary self-reported pain labels.
The record describes 17 healthy participants with DOMS and 6 participants with shoulder musculoskeletal disorders.
ограничения_валидации: Labels are binary self-reports collected during industrial tasks, not a continuous clinical pain endpoint.
Files total 12.5 GB; this audit checked metadata and file inventory, not the signal contents.
ресурсы.назначение: Multimodal human musculoskeletal-pain dataset with ECG, sEMG, IMU and binary self-report labels.

ресурсы.данные: IMU + sEMG; хроническая боль в спине; упражнения
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: The former generic NIT link was replaced with the official UCL dataset page.
проверенные_утверждения: The UCL page describes 18 IMUs and four sEMG sensors for 12 healthy and 18 chronic-pain participants.
Protective behaviour was independently annotated by four domain experts.
ограничения_валидации: Access to the body-movement component requires contacting the dataset owner.
Protective behaviour is not interchangeable with pain intensity or a clinical outcome.
ресурсы.назначение: Controlled-access movement, sEMG and annotation resource for chronic-pain protective behaviour research.

ресурсы.данные: sEMG + NIRS; интенсивность скелетно-мышечной боли; стандартизированный jaw-clenching task
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Do not use the imported modality or task claims as facts unless a primary record is supplied.
ограничения_валидации: No primary dataset matching the imported name, modalities and jaw-clenching description was found.
The supplied odesi.ca domain is a catalogue landing page and does not identify this resource.
ресурсы.назначение: Rejected candidate: no stable identifier or exact primary record could be established.

ресурсы.данные: ЭЭГ-BIDS; хроническая боль; open access
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Verified through the OSF API because the browser landing page returns an automated-access error.
проверенные_утверждения: OSF identifies the project as Effects of analgesics on EEG biomarkers of chronic pain.
The public storage contains BIDS archives and clinical spreadsheets for two cohorts.
ограничения_валидации: The imported name OpenPain was incorrect and has been removed from the resource purpose.
The multi-gigabyte archives were not downloaded or independently checked for BIDS validity.
ресурсы.назначение: Public OSF project containing BIDS EEG archives and clinical variables for analgesic effects on chronic-pain EEG biomarkers.

ресурсы.данные: Resting-state ЭЭГ; хроническая боль; PainLabMunich
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Corrected to the closest documented primary project; original identifier remains disproven.
проверенные_утверждения: A public PainLabMunich OSF project exists for resting-state EEG from 101 chronic-pain patients and 88 matched controls.
ограничения_валидации: The imported OSF identifier hbkmx returns 404 and could not be validated.
The replacement srpbg project is a specific PainLabMunich dataset, not a generic record for every lab dataset.
ресурсы.назначение: PainLabMunich resting-state EEG dataset for chronic-pain microstate analysis, represented by the verified srpbg project.

ресурсы.данные: 36 пациентов; eyes open/closed; painDETECT + BPI
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Exact Mendeley version and data article were matched.
проверенные_утверждения: Mendeley Data DOI 10.17632/yj52xrfgtz.4 contains resting-state EEG and questionnaire data from 36 chronic neuropathic-pain patients.
The protocol includes five minutes eyes open, five minutes eyes closed, painDETECT and Brief Pain Inventory reports.
ограничения_валидации: The dataset has no healthy control group and contains heterogeneous etiologies and medication exposure.
It supports within-cohort association or stratification, not causal or population-wide pain inference.
ресурсы.назначение: Resting-state EEG plus painDETECT and Brief Pain Inventory data for 36 chronic neuropathic-pain patients.

ресурсы.данные: 180 субъектов; ЭЭГ; 4 ch, 178 Hz, BIDS
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Nociception-monitor output and behavioural responsiveness must remain distinct from subjective pain.
проверенные_утверждения: OpenNeuro identifier ds008115 resolves to the ValidPain2 EEG dataset under DOI 10.18112/openneuro.ds008115.v1.0.0.
Catalogue metadata reports 180 mechanically ventilated intensive-care patients, four EEG channels and three clinical-procedure tasks.
ограничения_валидации: Patients were unable to self-report pain; the target concerns responsiveness to potentially nociceptive procedures, not subjective pain intensity.
Signal files were not downloaded or independently quality-controlled in this audit.
ресурсы.назначение: Frontal EEG dataset for responsiveness to potentially nociceptive procedures in mechanically ventilated ICU patients.

ресурсы.данные: 64/128 ch resting-state ЭЭГ; ампутанты с фантомной болью
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: OpenNeuro DOI 10.18112/openneuro.ds006921.v1.1.1 is linked by NEMAR.
проверенные_утверждения: NEMAR on006921 provides 64/128-channel resting-state EEG from 38 participants across amputee and intact-control groups.
The BIDS dataset includes eyes-open/eyes-closed tasks and pain-related phenotype data.
ограничения_валидации: This is a resting-state group-comparison resource, not an evoked pain-intensity dataset.
NEMAR data-quality summaries were not yet published on the checked page.
ресурсы.назначение: High-density resting-state EEG and phenotype data for phantom-limb-pain, amputee-control and intact-control groups.

ресурсы.данные: ЭЭГ-BIDS; expectation модулирует repetition suppression
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: The imported causal-sounding summary was narrowed to the study question.
проверенные_утверждения: OpenNeuro ds006374 contains EEG and behavioural data from 36 participants under DOI 10.18112/openneuro.ds006374.v1.0.0.
The listed tasks are calibration, expectation/repetition-suppression and detection.
ограничения_валидации: The source supports study of expectation and nociceptive responses; it does not establish that expectation modulates repetition suppression.
The repository reports many BIDS warnings, so preprocessing assumptions require review before use.
ресурсы.назначение: EEG/behavioural dataset for testing expectation effects on repetition suppression in nociception.

ресурсы.данные: 30 ch ЭЭГ; knee pain; motor imagery
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Exact Figshare record and known completeness caveats were captured.
проверенные_утверждения: The dataset contains 30-channel, 500-Hz EEG from 30 knee-pain patients performing left/right leg motor imagery.
The associated publication DOI is 10.1038/s41597-025-05767-2.
ограничения_валидации: The target is motor-imagery class, not pain intensity or nociceptive response.
MOABB reports 32 of 150 raw sessions missing and a label-mapping inconsistency between README and events metadata.
ресурсы.назначение: Lower-limb motor-imagery EEG dataset from knee-pain patients; useful as clinical-domain representation data, not a pain-label benchmark.

ресурсы.данные: 200 MB; fNIRS; thermal quantitative sensory testing
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Updated to the current Mendeley version 2 record.
проверенные_утверждения: Mendeley Data DOI 10.17632/kb9pb6tzkg.2 provides fNIRS data and code for 16 participants across cold/heat threshold and tolerance tasks.
The record includes raw and filtered haemoglobin signals plus k-fold and leave-one-subject-out training code.
ограничения_валидации: Threshold/tolerance task labels are protocol-derived and are not interchangeable with clinical pain states.
Published model results and code reproducibility were not independently rerun.
ресурсы.назначение: Evoked fNIRS and code for thermal quantitative sensory testing across cold/heat threshold and tolerance conditions.

ресурсы.данные: fNIRS; painful thermal + electrical stimuli; finger-tapping
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Exact NEMAR/OpenNeuro identifiers were recorded.
проверенные_утверждения: NEMAR on005776 contains NIRS data from 11 participants across electrical, thermal, finger-tapping, imagery and resting tasks.
The record links OpenNeuro DOI 10.18112/openneuro.ds005776.v1.0.1 and two associated publications.
ограничения_валидации: The catalogue description mixes painful stimulation and motor tasks; task-level event semantics must be inspected before modeling.
No independent signal-quality analysis was performed.
ресурсы.назначение: BIDS fNIRS dataset combining noxious electrical/thermal stimulation and motor-control tasks.

ресурсы.данные: fNIRS; morphine analgesia + placebo effects
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Exact NEMAR/OpenNeuro identifiers were recorded.
проверенные_утверждения: NEMAR on005777 contains NIRS data from 14 participants under baseline, morphine and placebo conditions.
The record links OpenNeuro DOI 10.18112/openneuro.ds005777.v1.0.1 and article DOI 10.3389/fnhum.2018.00394.
ограничения_валидации: The small pharmacological experiment is not a general clinical-pain dataset.
No independent signal-quality or treatment-effect reproduction was performed.
ресурсы.назначение: BIDS fNIRS dataset for neural responses to electrical stimulation under baseline, morphine and placebo conditions.

ресурсы.данные: fNIRS; painful stimuli; morphine vs placebo
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Count as source provenance, not as a second independent dataset.
проверенные_утверждения: The NITRC project page describes fNIRS during electrical pain under morphine and placebo conditions.
The page links the same 2018 study represented by the NEMAR/OpenNeuro on005777 record.
ограничения_валидации: This is an alternate project portal for the ST046 study, not an independent cohort.
The checked NITRC page does not establish that downloadable files remain available there.
ресурсы.назначение: Legacy NITRC project page for the morphine/placebo fNIRS study also preserved in NEMAR/OpenNeuro.

ресурсы.данные: fNIRS; 11 subjects; innocuous + noxious electrical stimulus
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Count as source provenance, not as a second independent dataset.
проверенные_утверждения: The NITRC page describes fNIRS from 11 participants receiving innocuous and noxious electrical stimuli.
The project links publication DOI 10.1038/srep09469.
ограничения_валидации: This portal overlaps the electrical-stimulation component represented in ST045 and is not an independent cohort.
Thermal and motor tasks available in the later NEMAR package are not established by this page alone.
ресурсы.назначение: Legacy NITRC page for the 11-participant electrical-stimulation fNIRS study represented in the broader NEMAR package.

ресурсы.назначение: Open CAD/STL anatomical resource for constructing conventional, high-frequency, DRG and trans-spinal stimulation models.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Exact Zenodo record and model/software distinction were confirmed.
проверенные_утверждения: Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.3732197 provides RADO-SCS 3.0 CAD/STL anatomy for T9-T11 and clinical leads.
The record documents a 0.1-mm anatomical representation and a FEM-to-axon modeling workflow.
ограничения_валидации: RADO-SCS is a CAD-derived model resource, not executable SCS modeling software.
It does not include pathological or patient-specific spinal anatomy.

ресурсы.назначение: NEURON-based biophysical SCS model and analysis code for motor-circuit mechanisms after spinal-cord injury.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Relevant as mechanistic software, not as a pain-outcome model.
проверенные_утверждения: Repository contains NEURON simulation and EMG-analysis code underlying Balaguer et al. (2025).
It models interaction of epidural SCS, supraspinal input and motoneuron pools after spinal injury.
ограничения_валидации: The model addresses motor control after spinal-cord injury, not chronic-pain relief or ECAP prediction.
Local reproducibility and parameter provenance were not independently tested.

ресурсы.назначение: NEURON/NetPyNE implementation of a published spinal-cord-stimulation network model.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Execution and numerical reproduction remain a later feasibility gate.
проверенные_утверждения: Repository provides NEURON/NetPyNE code intended to reproduce the SCS network model from Sagalajev et al.
The README links DOI 10.1016/j.neuron.2023.10.021.
ограничения_валидации: The repository is small and has no release package or automated reproducibility evidence.
Its pain-suppression mechanism is a model hypothesis, not a clinical-outcome predictor.

ресурсы.назначение: General multiscale Python framework for in-silico peripheral-nerve stimulation.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Potential component only; spinal-cord applicability requires a separate model.
проверенные_утверждения: NRV is an actively developed Python library for peripheral nervous-system stimulation modeling.
The repository includes documentation, examples, tests and tutorials.
ограничения_валидации: NRV targets peripheral nerves and is not a ready-made spinal-cord or ECAP model.
Its redirected organization URL should replace the former personal-repository URL.

ресурсы.назначение: Open programmable transcutaneous current-stimulator hardware design for engineering reference only.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Not authorized here for human use or self-experimentation.
проверенные_утверждения: Repository publishes an open design for a programmable transcutaneous current stimulator.
ограничения_валидации: This is stimulation hardware, not a validated SCS simulator, dataset or clinical device.
Safety, regulatory status and suitability for any human experiment are not established by the repository.

ресурсы.назначение: Review framework for biophysical and surrogate digital twins used to optimize neural interfaces, including SCS.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Use for modeling requirements and limitations, not implementation evidence.
проверенные_утверждения: The 2026 review describes hybrid volume-conduction, neural-response and transduction models plus surrogate optimization.
It surveys SCS among several neuroprosthetic applications and identifies calibration and personalization limits.
ограничения_валидации: This is a review and conceptual framework, not a released SCS digital-twin implementation or dataset.
The paper notes that subject-specific calibration remains early and assumptions are substantial.

ресурсы.назначение: FAU research-program page on multiscale spinal-cord digital twins and Pareto-oriented eSCS design.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Treat as prospective prior art, not a reusable artifact.
проверенные_утверждения: The FAU project page states an aim to create multiscale spinal-cord digital twins and explore Pareto-optimal parameter solutions.
ограничения_валидации: The page describes an ongoing research direction and provides no validated software, dataset or clinical results.
No patient-specific pain or ECAP prediction claim is supported.

ресурсы.название: FlyWire: Method of the Year 2025 (Nature Methods)
ресурсы.назначение: Editorial context for EM-based connectomics and the methodological significance of FlyWire-scale reconstructions.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Resource title was broader than the verified editorial scope and is corrected in purpose.
проверенные_утверждения: Nature Methods selected electron-microscopy-based connectomics as Method of the Year 2025.
The editorial discusses whole-brain Drosophila/FlyWire and other connectomics achievements.
ограничения_валидации: The award is for EM-based connectomics broadly, not for FlyWire alone.
An editorial distinction is not validation of a particular simulator or pain-transfer hypothesis.

ресурсы.название: LIF model from Shiu et al. (Nature 2024)
ресурсы.назначение: Primary whole-central-brain LIF model for experimentally testable feeding and grooming sensorimotor circuits.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: The imported global 91% accuracy claim was narrowed to the actual evaluation.
проверенные_утверждения: The article implements a Brian2 LIF model of 127,400 central-brain neurons using FlyWire connectivity and transmitter identity.
Feeding and grooming predictions were tested with optogenetics, imaging and behaviour; one unbiased cell-type screen exceeded 90% accuracy.
ограничения_валидации: The greater-than-90% result is task- and screen-specific, not 91% whole-brain prediction accuracy.
The authors note zero baseline firing, missing neuromodulation and inaccurate absolute firing-rate assumptions.

ресурсы.назначение: Primary EVOKE randomized-trial evidence for ECAP-controlled closed-loop versus open-loop SCS.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Underlying trial verified; the imported secondary-publication attribution remains unverified.
проверенные_утверждения: The EVOKE blinded randomized trial NCT02924129 compared ECAP-controlled closed-loop with fixed-output open-loop SCS.
At 36 months the publication reports 77.6% versus 49.3% achieving at least 50% overall back/leg pain reduction.
ограничения_валидации: The imported JPHV 2026 pooled-analysis identity was not confirmed as a stable primary publication.
The RR 1.47 figure must not replace the directly reported time-specific trial results and confidence intervals.

ресурсы.назначение: Scoping review of control signals used in closed-loop SCS for chronic pain.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Exact DOI 10.1016/j.neurom.2025.11.011 and counts were confirmed.
проверенные_утверждения: The scoping review screened 688 unique articles and retained 28 publications covering 19 unique studies.
It categorized three subjective-state, seven position/movement and nine ECAP-control studies and found no fully integrated subjective-plus-biophysical model.
ограничения_валидации: The result is a literature-gap statement, not proof that such integration improves outcomes.
ECAP is treated as spinal activation and a proxy for delivery changes, not direct pain intensity.

ресурсы.назначение: Company technical account of an experimental FlyWire-LIF and NeuroMechFly/MuJoCo integration.
ресурсы.примечание_валидации: Do not cite it as validated brain upload, nociception model or emergent-behaviour evidence.
проверенные_утверждения: Eon describes integration of a FlyWire-derived LIF brain model with a NeuroMechFly/MuJoCo body.
The page identifies the work as an integration of existing brain and body models and discusses roughly 140,000 neurons and 50 million synapses.
ограничения_валидации: The source is a company-authored demonstration, not peer-reviewed independent validation of embodied whole-brain emulation.
The demonstrated behaviours and brain-body interface require code, protocol and ablation review before scientific use.

notes: BioVid требует соглашения для некоммерческого исследования; AI4PAIN использует регистрацию/EULA; PainMonit доступен через Figshare.
На первом проходе не подтвержден открытый человеческий набор, одновременно содержащий SCS/ECAP и клинический исход боли.
FlyWire FAFB v783 описывает мозг взрослой самки, а не VNC/тело; анатомическая связность не задает физиологическую динамику.
NeuroMechFly/FlyGym является embodied sensorimotor framework, но не содержит готовой модели ноцицепции, ECAP или человеческой SCS.
Непроверенные ресурсы и общие доменные ссылки нельзя использовать в ИПР, статье или заявке на новизну до валидации.
